verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents a first-party Automations feature that fires preset actions on events: Epics auto-start and auto-complete, future Iterations are auto-created, and unfinished Stories move to the next Iteration. The evidence shows only these fixed, predefined automations, with no user-definable rule builder of the trigger-condition-action kind. Missing for 10: user-defined custom rules with arbitrary triggers and actions, detailed documentation of automation configuration, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Automations Auto-start and auto-complete an Epic, auto-create future Iterations, and move unfinished Stories to the next Iteration
